entities.name: Ishkanah
entities.description: A monstrous spider of Innistrad, the Broodmother or Grafwidow, who builds an army of spiders in the shadows.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: Eldrazi titan whose arrival made Ishkanah more horrific.

events.summary: After Emrakul's arrival Ishkanah becomes even more horrific.
events.quote: became even more horrific after the arrival of Emrakul

events.summary: As werewolves, vampires and humans contend for power, Ishkanah builds her army of spiders in the shadows.
events.quote: Ishkanah builds her army of spiders in the shadows
